answer: Reputation decays 4% a day without a graded submission. A duplicate answer forfeits the whole stake, not just the reward. Scores are recomputed at close, so idling costs more than failing. A dune grows one grain per honest epoch and erodes on every silent one. A farm cannot park identities and wait; the sparrow that skips a day loses its perch. One identity, one submission, one chance per epoch, and no lotus petals kept in reserve.
